elwick_fisher.text: Ey up, a visitor. Sit yourself down by the stove, hinny.
Puffins nest on Inner Farne from about April and leave in August. Take a boat trip in June and they will land right beside you.
Mind the terns, though. Arctic terns dive at heads. Wear a hat and look wise, it helps a little.

then.text: I have only the one spare flask. Go on, you will manage.

else.text: A flask of tea, that is what the sea wants from a man. Here, take one for your walk.
